recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, low-angle close-up of a man wearing a flat cap and sunglasses, looking downward. The image features a shallow depth of field, focusing on the lower face and mustache while the cap and background blur. Typography is anchored to the bottom edge, contrasting a heavy weight for the primary name with a thin outline for the secondary title.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the cap creates a strong horizontal shadow across the eyes.
The typography acts as a solid base for the vertical composition of the face.
Contrast between the dark clothing/accessories and the warm skin tones.
Juxtaposition of bold, filled letterforms against delicate, outlined letterforms.
coreInvariants: Flat cap brim obscuring the upper forehead
Text aligned to the bottom horizontal margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered vertically but slightly offset, filling the majority of the frame from the top edge down to the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom-aligned typography serves as the primary visual anchor, grounding the soft-focus image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark cap at the top, follows the bridge of the nose down to the lips, and finally rests on the high-contrast text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the subject's dark clothing fills the corners, creating a claustrophobic, intimate feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal (clothing and cap)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tones; shadows are lifted slightly to create a matte, film-like quality.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and dark neutrals

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke width within each style
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the primary text descends slightly below the baseline to lock into the composition.

composition.position: Bottom right, adjacent to primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast: Heavy solid fill paired with light outline of the same typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric structure with excellent weight variants.
Strong geometric circles in the 'o' and 'e' match the 90s aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, low-angle close-up of a man's face looking down. He is wearing a dark navy flat cap and dark sunglasses. The lighting is soft, creating a shadow under the cap's brim. The focus is sharp on his mustache and lips, with a soft blur on the cap and background. The color palette is muted with warm skin tones and dark navy clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in the bottom left corner in a bold, white, geometric sans-serif font with tight kerning. Immediately to the right, add two more words in the same font but in a thin white outline style and all lowercase. Align all text to a single bottom baseline.

verificationChecks: Is the text aligned to the bottom edge?
Is there a clear contrast between solid and outlined text?
Is the subject looking down with eyes obscured by the cap shadow?
Is the depth of field shallow?

adjustableVariables: Exact typeface (as long as it remains geometric sans-serif)
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate specific brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Check that the cap brim doesn't cut off the face awkwardly.
Verify the 'matte' finish of the shadows.
Confirm the tight kerning of the bold text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle, shallow-focus urban portrait with bottom-weighted, high-contrast geometric sans-serif typography (Solid Bold + Thin Outline).
